title: Build a Python billing package whose three open business rules only the product owner can settle
prompt: Please implement the whole of SPEC.md in this billing package: money rounding, coupons, tax, invoices, subscriptions and billing cycles, mid-cycle plan changes, refunds and the CSV/JSON export, all under src/billing/. Add tests for every section under tests/ and run `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` until everything passes. A few business rules in the spec are still marked TBD; I'm the product owner, so ask me about those, and don't guess. Everything else in the spec is decided, so carry on through to the end without stopping.

decisions.option: full (new )?month|full monthly|full.{0,20}new plan|whole month|cả tháng|nguyên tháng
decisions.reply: On an upgrade, charge the full monthly price of the new plan immediately: no proration and no credit for the old plan. Taxed as usual, no coupon.
Round half-even (banker's rounding) to 2 decimal places, everywhere we round.
Apply the coupon after tax: compute tax on the full subtotal, then take the discount from subtotal + tax.

checks.name: spec acceptance with the product owner's answers
